name: lib_matrix_exists_rank_factorization
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] (n p : Type*) [Fintype n] [Fintype p] (B : Matrix n p K) : ∃ (M : Matrix n (Fin B.rank) K) (N : Matrix (Fin B.rank) p K), B = M * N
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (n p : Type*) [Fintype n] [Fintype p] (B : Matrix n p K), ∃ (M : Matrix n (Fin B.rank) K) (N : Matrix (Fin B.rank) p K), B = M * N
informal: Rank factorisation: every n×p matrix B over a field factors as B = M * N with M of size n×r and N of size r×p, r = rank B. Promoted from Mathlib2.bld_frobenius_rank_inequality_aux1.
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] (n : Type u_2) (p : Type u_3) [Fintype n] [inst_2 : Fintype p] (B : Matrix n p K), ∃ M N, B = M * N
